products.name: LG 14 place setting dishwasher with TrueSteam and QuadWash
products.summary: Drop the door, pull out the lower and upper racks and see the QuadWash spray arms and the TrueSteam nozzles, then place it in your kitchen at its real size.
products.arTip: Tap the door to open it
products.sizeNote: 85 cm tall and 60 cm deep with the door shut; the door drops down in front of it to open
specs: Auto, Intensive, Delicate, Refresh, Eco, Turbo, Machine Clean, Rinse, Express, Download Cycle
Dual Zone, Half Load, Energy Saver, Steam, High Temp., Extra Dry, Delay Start
EasyRack Plus: upper rack adjusts to 3 heights, foldable tines, cutlery basket
Inverter Direct Drive, 10 year warranty on the motor (2 years parts and labour + 8 years motor parts)
LG ThinQ (Wi-Fi): download cycles, Smart Diagnosis

hotspots.title: Download Cycles
hotspots.text: With the LG ThinQ smartphone app, download new wash cycles to meet your needs—such as Pots & Pans, Casseroles, Glassware and Night Care.

hotspots.title: TrueSteam®
hotspots.text: TrueSteam® made by boiling water reaches the entire surface of every dish inside the tub resulting in sparkling clean dishes. Pure water particles of steam also help reduce water spots.

hotspots.title: QuadWash™
hotspots.text: With four spray arms instead of two, QuadWash™ provides stronger cleaning performance to clean every dish on every rack.

hotspots.title: EasyRack™ Plus
hotspots.text: Adjust the height of the upper rack to three different levels to load taller items on any rack.

fit.note: From LG's owner's manual: in a corner, leave at least 5 cm between the dishwasher and the cabinet or wall beside it, and place it within 1 metre of the sink for the drain hose.
